about: Public-notice channels per operator or agency: pages, sites, feeds, lists and accounts through which the public is told of sewage discharges, by law, permit or voluntarily. Read by pipeline/ingest/notification_pages.py (schema and validator there; test tests/test_notice_channels.py).

channels.name: 528 Partnership LLP Brown & Bigelow Bldg
channels.legal_basis: Minn. Stat. 115.061(c): promptly after reporting a discharge to the agency, a publicly owned treatment works or a publicly or privately owned domestic sewer system owner must notify potentially impacted downstream users, including the public, Tribal governments and drinking water facilities, by the most efficient communications system available (in person, telephone, radio, social media, web page or another expedited form), and post signs at impacted public use areas or notify the entity with jurisdiction over them
channels.note: 528 Partnership LLP Brown & Bigelow Bldg must tell downstream users and the public of a discharge by the means it chooses (in person, telephone, radio, social media or a web page) and post signs at affected public use areas; its own public channel was not searched individually. The duty binds a private sewer system owner as it binds a public one.
